title: SR-71 pilot encourages Sherman to join the Air Force

tellings.quote: Um and of course the SR71 pilot he really encouraged me to go in the Air Force

plain: A pilot of the SR-71, a very fast, high-flying American spy plane, strongly urged a young Dan Sherman to join the Air Force. Sherman tells this from his own life. He is a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US government's code-breaking and eavesdropping agency, later hired him to communicate with aliens, and he points to his book Above Black for his story.
